vb_textbox.text: To get a good score in this game what you should do is, when you choose a gnome if the score is high then during the next round choose the gnome in that side again. If the score is still high then continue doing this, If the score is low for example 2 points then choose the other gnome and if that gnome has higher points stick with that one and swap to the opposite gnome if the points are too low.
